body.name: \(G(h,k,\eta,\epsilon_n,\delta_n)\)
body.construction: \(G(h,k,\eta,\epsilon_n,\delta_n)=C_G\frac{\sqrt{\log(1/\delta_n)\log(8/\eta)}}{m\epsilon_n}\{h^{-d}+k h^{-2d}\}\), the Gaussian quantile obtained from the joint sensitivity of the clipped linear and order-two moment vector after spectral stabilization.
